maddeler.e:
احتضنوا (form VIII)
# اِحْتَضَنُوا (iḥtaḍanū) /iħ.ta.dˤa.nuː/: third-person masculine plural past active of اِحْتَضَنَ (iḥtaḍana)
# اُحْتُضِنُوا (uḥtuḍinū) /uħ.tu.dˤi.nuː/: third-person masculine plural past passive of اِحْتَضَنَ (iḥtaḍana)
# اِحْتَضِنُوا (iḥtaḍinū) /iħ.ta.dˤi.nuː/: second-person masculine plural imperative of اِحْتَضَنَ (iḥtaḍana)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
